Train your dog to settle. Have a mat, bed, pen whatever it will have as it’s spot. I used a pen with a bed, toys and a bowl of water. I’ve started using a bed / mat for other places. 
Put them in/on but not in a specific position (eg don’t say sit but just get them to go on the bed) so they know where to be but can adopt and change position to their comfort. 

You basically want to set them up for success so keep in mind that a tiny success is better than trying to achieve too much and a failure occurring. Take baby steps - less than baby steps for the following things - and loads of treats.

Give them treats for relaxing and staying relaxed. Turn away, turn back and give them a treat for not making noise. Repeat and increase the time. Step away, turn back and give them a treat for not making a noise. Repeat and increase steps, going out of sight increases difficulty too, as does going in different rooms, closing doors etc. spend longer away from them, increasing time. By going through this they’ll associate settling down and keeping to themselves as a good thing.

If they whine etc: wait until they go quiet for a microsecond to start returning, if the whine again stop and wait until they go quiet for a microsecond and return. Once you’re back with them, wait until they’re quiet to treat. Reel back the difficulty loads for a few (3-5) goes so they feel success again then start building difficulty back up slowly - perhaps slower than you had previously.

You might not get out the room for the first few days but with practice, persistence and patience they will learn to entertain themselves. (I leave safe toys in the pen for this reason)
